title: glycosmis puberula var. subsessilis
intro: Glycosmis puberula var. subsessilis, commonly known as Java plum, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Java plum include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic actions and potential applications.
